summary: SDK bundle triggers generic HTTP/dyndns keyword patterns without evidence of exfiltration
details: Package ships a minified SDK bundle at dist/index.js. Pattern matches fire on the literal string 'POST' at multiple offsets and on the token 'dyndns' at line 44075 — keyword co-occurrence typical of any bundled HTTP client library. No hardcoded attacker-controlled destination is identified, no credential or environment-variable scraping is observed, and no lifecycle script (preinstall/install/postinstall) is present that would auto-execute code on install. The pattern hits are consistent with a normal SDK bundle exposing HTTP POST helpers, not with an active exfiltration or C2 channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
